visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static eye-level shot of a street in Zuoying, Kaohsiung, featuring a traditional food stall named 'Ah-Xing Rice Noodle' with a green awning. A man in a blue shirt is parked on a scooter in front of the stall, which has several red plastic stools and customers seated inside. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a floral-patterned bowl filled with rice noodle soup, garnished with cilantro and pieces of pork; a pair of wooden chopsticks lifts a bundle of thin white rice noodles from the steaming broth. (3) A cook's hands, wearing black nitrile gloves, are shown ladling a thick, translucent brown soup containing chunks of pork from a large stainless steel vat into a bowl. (4) A red plastic bottle is squeezed, pouring a vibrant red chili sauce over the rice noodles in the bowl, followed by a close-up of the noodles being mixed with the sauce. (5) A plate of 'hei-bai-qie' (boiled pork offal) is presented, featuring sliced liver, heart, and intestines topped with ginger shreds and cilantro. (6) The camera pans over a metal tray at the stall counter stacked with various cooked pork organs including coils of intestines and large pieces of lean meat. (7) A close-up shows a cook wearing blue gloves using a large metal cleaver to rapidly slice boiled pork intestines on a thick wooden cutting board. (8) The sliced meats are neatly arranged on a white plate alongside fresh ginger strips, cilantro, and minced garlic; a metal ladle then pours a thin, savory brown sauce over the entire dish. (9) A metal spoon scoops out a portion of bright red chili oil with visible seeds from a stainless steel container and places it onto the side of the meat plate. (10) The final shot shows the storefront again, displaying a red banner with 'Ah-Xing Rice Noodle' and the address while two female staff members work behind the counter.

Faint street ambience like distant engine hum is barely audible. (2) As the narrator describes the soup, a subtle splashing sound of liquid being ladled is heard. The vocal pitch is moderately high and enthusiastic. (3) A series of rhythmic, crisp thudding sounds occurs as meat is chopped on a wooden board. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (4) A soft mechanical click or lid-opening sound is heard during the close-up of the chili oil. The narrator's tone shifts to a concluding, inviting inflection as he provides the address and a sign-off.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and promote a long-standing, 60-year-old local food stall in Zuoying, Kaohsiung. It focuses on the sensory appeal of its signature rice noodle soup and 'hei-bai-qie', emphasizing freshness and traditional preparation to attract food enthusiasts.
